name: Proexochokefalos
sum: Proexochokefalos is a large machimosaurid teleosauroid from the Middle Jurassic of Normandy, France, known from a skull and mandible.
wsnote: The skull and mandible measure about 1.1 m; the sources consulted give no total body length.
holotype: MNHN.F 1890-13, a complete skull and mandible from the Marnes de Dives near Villers-sur-Mer, Calvados, Normandy (the page does not label it holotype; Brignon 2018 does).
material: The skull and mandible; P. cf. bouchardi from the Calcaire de Caen (France) and Reuchenette Formation (Switzerland) is assigned tentatively.
biology: Described as a large-bodied marine teleosauroid; the sources consulted give no more on diet or habits here.
author: Johnson et al. 2020

sources.text: Johnson, M. M., Young, M. T. and Brusatte, S. L. 2020. The phylogenetics of Teleosauroidea (Crocodylomorpha, Thalattosuchia) and implications for their ecology and evolution. PeerJ 8: e9808.

Johnson, M. M., Foffa, D., Young, M. T. and Brusatte, S. L. 2022. The ecological diversification and evolution of Teleosauroidea (Crocodylomorpha, Thalattosuchia), with insights into their mandibular biomechanics. Ecology and Evolution 12(11): e9484.
Morel de Glasville, M. 1876. Sur la cavité crânienne et la position du trou optique dans le Steneosaurus heberti. Bulletin de la Société Géologique de France (3) 4: 342–348.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. The type horizon is Callovian (English Wikipedia); referred material is dated only loosely Middle to Late Jurassic, so the Callovian is used.
